blocks.html: Boilers shall be mounted on floors of noncombustible construction, unless listed for mounting on combustible flooring. Vibration isolation shall be in accordance with Section 313. In buildings with residential occupancies, boilers shall be installed in accordance with the requirements of Section 313.
